summary: Maintains visual expectation strategies, tokens, components and themes, with isolated candidate exploration and adoption.
runtime_notes: The Agent invokes managed-case mode only when the current dynamic gap needs visual facts; the skill returns an evidence-backed fact_result and standalone mode remains available.

Formal visual changes need an explicit human or stable fact basis. Authorized exploration may produce isolated candidates before that choice; report pending choices as needs_human and never claim Case resolution.

Candidate artifacts stay in the domain _explorations directory; return unresolved choices without asserting stable fact updates or writing Case State. Existing user decisions authorize adoption; never infer approval from implementation.
